evidence.title: GitHub - statico/smui: 🪐 A dark terminal-aesthetic theme for shadcn/ui. Nord-inspired colors, JetBrains Mono everywhere, zero border radius.

name: smui
summary: Nord-inspired terminal theme for shadcn/ui with JetBrains Mono, zero border radius and light/dark palettes.
description: A shadcn registry theme that remaps every shadcn/ui CSS variable to a Nord palette (4 frost blues, 5 aurora status colors, four surface levels) with zero border radius and monospace typography. Install with npx shadcn add or copy the CSS; the site ships a component showcase, a bridge-dashboard layout example, a design guide and a skill.md written for coding agents.
contains: Nord palette: 4 frost blues + 5 aurora status colors, surface levels 0-3
zero border radius, JetBrains Mono, uppercase labels
light (Snow Storm) and dark (Polar Night) modes
skill.md for coding agents and AESTHETIC.md design patterns
component showcase and bridge dashboard layout example
